name: aircode
description: Cursor-like coding agent client powered by Claude Agent SDK

scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:runtime && pnpm run build:server
scripts.dev:server: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:runtime && pnpm run build:server && node --watch apps/server/dist/index.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:runtime && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
